description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.38.0-dev.1-dualvot.8.1

Pre-release update based on Morphe Patches 1.38.0-dev.1.

### Yandex player button

- Integrate the Yandex translation button with restored thin player controls.
- Use separate thin legacy and bold modern icons so each matches its player style.
- Compact all five optional controls in portrait and give them balanced spacing in landscape, in both player styles.

### Validation

- Android patch bundle compiled successfully.
- Both player styles and five-button portrait/landscape layouts were tested on a device.
- Required Dual VoT integration sources, metadata, and bundle manifest were verified.
